content:
Headquarters: Remote - Americas, El Salvador
URL: http://bondex.app

We're recruiting a Web 3 Fullstack Developer (Solidity / Rust / Typescript) who is looking for a new challenge and ready to join an exciting new chapter to expand our clients product value proposition in the DeFi Web3 realm. 

 

The client is is revoluzionezing financial interoperability and the requirements for the role are: 

 

  • Minimum 4 years of professional experience in WEB development; preferably with Typescript
  • Experience as Fullstack Web3 developer at least 2 years in the following programming languages:
  • Web3: High level of Solidity (demonstrated experience) / Rust
  • FRONTEND: Typescript / Javascript / React / NodeJS
  • BACKEND: NodeJS; nice to have Golang & Python
  • FLUENT proficient English, passable and/or with strong accent will not do.
  • Ability to work with clients.
  • Desirable experience in Smart contracts and DeFi protocols (curve, uniswap, AAVE etc);

 

100% Remote but ONLY residents of countries with US time zones (EST-PST)

 

As a Web 3 Full stack developer, you're main responsibilities will be: 

 

  • Participate in the entire software development lifecycle;
  • Collaborate closely with developers and CTO to deliver high-quality software solutions;
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues, providing timely resolutions;

About the client: 

 

  • Remote first
  • We prioritise an optimal work-life balance, ensuring ample time for relaxation and personal pursuits.
  • Competitive salary according to experience and contributions

Hiring process: 

 

  1. Questionare application
  2. HR introduction call
  3. Technical interview + technical assesment
  4. Offer

 

If you're an experience web3 full stack developer eager to make a meaningful contribution to a cutting-edge project in the DeFi space, we would love to hear from you!

 

 

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bondex-fullstack-web3-engineer-solidity-rust-typescript
